summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed an 8-K to report a contractual amendment expanding the field of use in its license agreement with Paragon Therapeutics. The amendment removes prior restrictions that limited Spyre to inflammatory bowel disease, now covering all therapeutic uses, with temporary dosing restrictions for certain indications until 2028/2030. No change of control, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event occurred. This is a routine operational update to an existing license, not a transformative corporate event.
